nodes.label: Home Idle Rotation
nodes.rationale: Wall-clock slicing over homeDuration + eventDuration + reportDuration lets the clock, event images, and financial report rotate without per-mode timers; slices drop to zero when their data is absent.

nodes.label: Embedded Local Config Server
nodes.rationale: LAN-browser editing avoids an in-app settings UI and any cloud dependency; token-guarded /api routes plus a public /images route keep TV image loading plumbing-free.

nodes.label: PRD - Isyfi Pray (Masjid TV Prayer Display)
nodes.norm_label: prd - isyfi pray (masjid tv prayer display)

nodes.label: Config Layering
nodes.rationale: Defaults from AppConstants are merged with persisted SharedPreferences overrides and hot-applied via ConfigProvider.applyConfig, so POST /api/config takes effect on the next 1-second tick with no state-machine edits.

nodes.label: Jumat Translation at Five Sites
nodes.rationale: The jadwal map only knows Dzuhur, so the Friday Jumat rename is implemented independently at five sites; this has been a recurring bug source (CHANGELOG 1.2.1, 1.3.1) and all five sites must stay in sync.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: ui (presentational) feeds from app/providers (state), pure rules and models live in domain, and data holds repositories/services; dependencies point inward so behavior is testable outside widgets.

nodes.label: One-Second Heartbeat (_onTick)
nodes.rationale: A single Timer.periodic(1s) runs clock updates, jadwal fingerprint refresh, cycle logic, state transitions, live override, and midnight sync in order; currentDateTime is fake-time aware so the whole machine can be simulated.

nodes.label: Clock Validity Guard
nodes.rationale: Masjid TVs with wrong clocks (system year below 2025) would compute nonsense schedules, so the home screen shows a full-screen JAM TV BELUM DIATUR! warning instead of normal content.

nodes.label: Full Offline Operation
nodes.rationale: No cloud backend or accounts: prayer times are computed on-device and config is served over the LAN, so the display keeps working without internet; only Live Makkah and follower sync need a network.

nodes.label: Ihtiyat Rule
nodes.rationale: Kemenag ihtiyat safety margins shift raw times per prayer; salat times round leftover seconds up to the next minute while Syuruq/terbit floors them.

nodes.label: Prayer State Machine
nodes.rationale: One central 1-second tick in AppProvider drives every transition so screens stay purely presentational; exact-second triggering and startup resume make the cycle robust to TV reboots mid-adzan.

nodes.label: AI-Friendly PRD
nodes.rationale: Normal PRDs leave implementation details vague on purpose, forcing a coding agent to guess and produce inconsistent, buggy code. The AI-friendly format names every entity, field, and process explicitly so an agent can implement without a single clarifying question.

nodes.label: One Stitch Project per Platform
nodes.rationale: Mixing platforms in one Stitch project makes them share one design system and generation context, causing an agent reading the exported code to blend mobile-nav patterns into a desktop dashboard. One project per platform keeps each self-contained and unambiguous downstream.
